feed.title: Deterministic UTXO consolidation under volatile fee regimes

entry.title: Deterministic UTXO consolidation under volatile fee regimes
entry.summary: The recent enhancements made to the system have significantly improved user experience by providing clarity on how combining funds from different addresses impacts privacy. This transparency is particularly beneficial as it helps users make informed decisions regarding their transactions. By incorporating a feature that visually represents which addresses or groups of funds are about to be combined prior to confirmation, the system further minimizes the likelihood of unexpected outcomes. This proactive approach in managing user expectations not only simplifies the transaction process but also enhances overall security and user trust in the system.
